releaseInfo.releaseNotes: Zap combines AI text and screenshot tools with Drip Type (Option+5 on Mac, Alt+5 on Windows). Includes secure sign-in and sign-out, background window recovery, updated branding, and security hardening. Hosted AI requires an active subscription and service availability.

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Zap uses macOS System Events to type text into the application you choose.
extendInfo.NSAccessibilityUsageDescription: Zap needs Accessibility access to type text into other applications.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureDescription: Zap captures a screen only when you choose Capture in Zap. You can preview and crop it before sending it through Zap to NVIDIA.
